crossRefs.note: Yahweh spoke again to Ahaz, saying,

parallels.note: Yahweh smelled the pleasant aroma. Yahweh said in his heart, “I will not again curse the ground any more for man’s sake…
He spoke to him yet again, and said, “What if there are forty found there?” He said, “I will not do it for the forty’s…

translations.web: Yahweh spoke to me yet again, saying,
translations.bsb: And the LORD spoke to me further:
translations.kjv: The LORD spake also unto me again, saying,
translations.asv: And Jehovah spake unto me yet again, saying,
